hooks.command: [ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *..*|*/node_modules/*) exit 0;; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) npx --no-install oxlint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.md|*.yml|*.yaml) npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; exit 0
